sections.text: In misaalon se waazeh hai ke (هُمْ) ka matlab (woh log) hai aur yeh bahut se mardon ka zikr karne ke liye istemaal hota hai. items.hinglish: Aur halakat hai kaafiron ke liye sakht azab se aur qayamat ke din woh badnuma banaye gaye logon mein se honge

translations.hinglish: Aur halakat hai kaafiron ke liye sakht azab se aur qayamat ke din woh badnuma banaye gaye logon mein se honge
translations.en: And woe to the disbelievers from a severe punishment / and on the Day of Resurrection they will be of the despised
translations.ur: اور ہلاکت ہے کافروں کے لیے سخت عذاب سے اور قیامت کے دن وہ بدحال کیے گئے لوگوں میں سے ہوں گے
translations.hi: और हलाकत है काफ़िरों के लिए सख़्त अज़ाब से और क़यामत के दिन वह बदहाल किए गए लोगों में से होंगे

translations.hinglish: Aur woh ghaflat mein munh mode hue hain
translations.en: While they are heedless, turning away

translations.hi: और वह ग़फ़लत में मुँह मोड़े हुए हैं

translations.hi: और वह रुकू करने वाले हैं

translations.en: and they are disbelievers
and they are wrongdoers
and they are polytheists

items.hinglish: aur woh takabbur karne wale hain

translations.hinglish: aur woh takabbur karne wale hain
translations.en: and they are arrogant

translations.hi: और वह तकब्बुर करने वाले हैं

translations.en: and they are safe

while they are asleep
and they are defiantly disobedient

items.hinglish: aur woh napasand karne wale hain

translations.hinglish: aur woh napasand karne wale hain
translations.en: while they are averse
translations.ur: اور وہ ناپسند کرنے والے ہیں
translations.hi: और वह नापसंद करने वाले हैं

items.hinglish: aur woh aeraaz karne wale hain

translations.hinglish: aur woh aeraaz karne wale hain
translations.en: and they are turning away
translations.ur: اور وہ اعراض کرنے والے ہیں
translations.hi: और वह मुँह मोड़ने वाले हैं

translations.en: while they were sound
and they will be honored
translations.ur: اور ان کی عزت کی جائے گی

it is they who are the guided

translations.en: it is they who are the liars
it is they who are astray
it is they who are the supporters of truth
it is they who are the disbelievers

items.hinglish: wahi log doguna karne wale hain

translations.hinglish: wahi log doguna karne wale hain
translations.en: it is they who will receive manifold increase
translations.ur: وہی لوگ دوگنا کرنے والے ہیں
translations.hi: वही लोग दोगुना करने वाले हैं

translations.en: it is they who are guided

items.hinglish: wahi log ziyadati karne wale hain

translations.hinglish: wahi log ziyadati karne wale hain
translations.en: it is they who are the transgressors

translations.en: it is they who are the transgressors
translations.ur: وہی لوگ حد سے بڑھنے والے ہیں
translations.hi: वही लोग हद से बढ़ने वाले हैं
